entities.name: Voluptara Highwater
entities.description: A female demon, minion and advisor of Davriel Cane, known as one of the most dangerous and wily demons of the Nexrix Flame Expanse. She wears human clothing and has ashen grey skin, dark red eyes and small horns.

entities.name: Davriel Cane
entities.description: The master whom the demon Voluptara Highwater serves as minion and advisor.

entities.name: Nexrix Flame Expanse
entities.description: The realm from which Voluptara Highwater comes, home to dangerous and wily demons.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane whose secondary and minor characters this page lists.
